follow-up time: Not specified, but re-laparotomies were categorized as occurring within 24 hours, within the first week, and beyond the first week following cesarean section.
cohort: 35,779 women who gave birth, including 7,926 who underwent cesarean section and 62 who underwent re-laparotomy following C-section
finding: Risk factors for re-laparotomy following cesarean section include previous abdominal and/or pelvic surgeries and intra-operative adhesions.
